item.title: Welcome to my website!
item.description:
I’m currently a 4th year undergraduate student at USC (University of Southern California) studying mathematics. Starting next fall, I’ll be a MASt in Mathematics student at University of Cambridge.

I’m interested in homotopy theory, plus its connetions to algebraic geometry and representation theory. I also have a side interest in theoretical computer science, in particular in computational social choice.

In a parallel universe, I might become a painter, a poker player, a detective novelist, or a football manager.
